meta.name: Bar Mitzvah Party
meta.description: Dance-party rig: 10x Rainbow pars uplighting the back wall behind a 30ft x 4ft stage, 2x 375Z on 8ft truss flanking the stage, 2x 375Z on the floor below the truss cross-shooting a 12x8 banner. Gold/blue/UV theme.

Tables on three sides of the 20x20 floor: truss beams never go to the floor (scripts/party-geometry.ts). Dance floor size + banner.centerHeightFt still come from the day-of plot sheet Saturday 2026-08-22; head positions from movingHeadSettings captured on site.
